notes.title: 1.5.0 Update
notes.notes: [h3]System Updates[/h3][p]- Added \[Gift], allowing you to gift pink or higher quality items by spending Soul Stones[/p][p]- Increased the number of weapons in a deck to 15[/p][p]- Added one-click medicine[/p][p]- Added automatic chest opening[/p][p]- Improved economy in ranked mode[/p][p]- Adjusted the mechanics of some enemies in stages[/p][p][/p][h3]Character Adjustments[/h3][p]- \[Song Jiang] Reworked[/p][p]- \[Jie Zhen] Reworked[/p][p]- \[Jie Bao] Reworked[/p][p]- \[Yang Chun] Reworked[/p][p]- \[Zhu Wu] Reworked[/p][p]- \[Xiang Chong] Reworked[/p][p]- \[Ruan Xiaoer] Reworked[/p][p]- \[Ruan Xiaoqi] Increased health cost when skills activate[/p][p]- \[Tang Long] Adjusted to unlock an additional weapon slot[/p][p]- \[Zhang Qing] Increases attack power and health when injured[/p][p]- \[Song Wan] Increases attack power and health when armor is gained[/p][p]- \[Duan Jingzhu] Adjusted to gain damage reduction before the start of the round, price reduced by 1[/p][p]- \[Du Xing] Price reduced by 1[/p][p]- \[Zhang Shun] Base Attributes reduced from 6-12 to 4-10[/p][p]- \[Zheng Tianshou] Health reduced from 12 to 10[/p][p]- \[Wu Song] Plunder attack power reduced by 1, plunder health reduced by 2%[/p][p]- \[Liu Tang] Mechanism attack power increased, health reduced[/p][p]- \[Ruan Xiaowu] Mechanism damage increased from 2 to 4[/p][p][/p][h3]Weapon Adjustments[/h3][p]- \[Plague Dagger] Increased poison stacks[/p][p]- \[Catalytic Shield] Increased damage reduction[/p][p]- \[Beast Bone - II] Price increased from 5 to 6[/p][p]- \[Beast Bone - III] Price increased from 7 to 9[/p][p]- \[Carved Feather Wooden Bow - I] Damage bonus reduced from 30% to 25%[/p][p]- \[Carved Feather Wooden Bow - II] Damage reduced from 60^ to 50%[/p][p]- \[Hook Spear] Price increased from 10 to 12[/p][p]- \[Speculation Blade] High-quality attributes increased, price increased[/p][p]- \[Yang Zhi's Pudao] Strength increased from 1 to 2, price increased from 2 to 4[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]- Fixed an issue with \[Gu Dasao]'s health recovery when the mechanism is triggered[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the attack order would be disrupted if a teammate in the back died first.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where Wu Song's combination with Gourd wouldn't work.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the Heavenly King's Tower only absorbed 2 HP.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the collection's assembly slot was full, preventing assembly.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the initial deck would be used with a certain chance.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where two cards could be opened in the Speed ​​Race card pool when only one card was left.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the equipment order was changing.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where red cards wouldn't disassemble.[/p]

notes.title: 1.4.2 Update
notes.notes: [h3]Character Adjustments[/h3][p]- \[Xiang Chong] Rework[/p][p]- \[Sun Erniang] Increased the number of stages of absorption[/p][p]- \[Lu Zhishen] Increased the initial value[/p][p]- \[Hu Yanzhuo] Increased the initial value[/p][p]- \[Hua Rong]'s attacks now take a portion of the victim's damage, and its attack power has been reduced from 10 to 8[/p][p]- \[Wu Song]'s health plundered has been changed from a fixed value to a percentage, and its bloodlust increases as it takes damage[/p][p]- \[Lu Junyi]'s mechanic effect has been increased from 25% to 50%, and its star upgrade effect has been significantly improved[/p][p]- \[Wu Yong] and \[Song Jiang]: When triggering a rebellion, the rebellious unit will now be at the front of the team[/p][p]- \[Song Jiang]'s price increased from 3 to 4[/p][p]- \[Gongsun Sheng]'s clone now appears at the front of the team, and its price increased from 3 to 4[/p][p]- \[Gu Dasao]'s price reduced from 3 to 2[/p][p][/p][h3]Weapon Adjustments[/h3][p]- \[Tianwang Tower] Rework[/p][p]- \[Gourd]'s mechanic has been added, and it now increases maximum health[/p][p][/p][h3]Enemy Adjustments[/h3][p]- Minor adjustments to the mechanics of Lu Qian and Sun Erniang[/p][p]- Weapon changes for Jiang Menshen and Xue Ba[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]- Fixed an issue where Huang Xin and Lin Chong's Hook Spear wasn't triggering.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where clicking the battle button in ranked matches wouldn't work.[/p]
